title: Glowing hole in bedroom wall and electrical failure

tellings.quote: there's about a 4 and 1 half or 5T hole diameter in a north wall of my bedroom

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear weapons site, says that in 2017 a glowing hole about four and a half or five feet across appeared in the north wall of his bedroom at his home in Georgia, and the electricity failed. He tells it as something he saw himself, part of the strange experiences he links to being taken by unknown beings.
